evidence.title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology

summary: New research explores methods for training and evaluating LLM-based agents in forecasting and prediction tasks. Another study introduces dynamic ontology to enhance the effectiveness and reliability of such agents.
title: Advancements in LLM-Based Agents for Forecasting and Reliable AI Systems
